correctness.rationale: For every odd prime power q and smooth parameter lambda outside {-2,-1,2} (with excluded values interpreted as a set in characteristic 3), the Jacobian criterion gives smoothness. Four sign lines, twelve mixed coefficient lines requiring t^2=-1/(lambda+1), and twelve coordinate-sparse lines with t roots of (lambda+2)(t^4+1)+2lambda t^2 are distinct and each restricts the quartic to a scalar square; the classical 28 odd-theta-characteristic count establishes completeness. Mixed lines descend precisely when -lambda-1 is a square, sparse lines precisely when it and lambda+2 are squares; over F_(q^2) both square classes split. Therefore the rational count is 4,16,28 with Frobenius cycle profiles 1^4 2^12, 1^16 2^6 and 1^28. Independent brute-force projective line enumeration tested every smooth lambda over F_5,F_7,F_11, using fresh binary-quartic square detection rather than the proposed 28-line list, matching all counts.
residual_risks: No characteristic-two or singular-quartic assertion; finite checks corroborate but do not replace the all-field algebraic proof.
